text: 上海国际能源交易中心：经研究决定，自2026年10月12日（星期一）收盘结算时起，涨跌停板幅度和交易保证金比例调整如下：原油期货SC2612、SC2701合约、低硫燃料油期货LU2612、LU2701合约的涨跌停板幅度为16%，套保持仓交易保证金比例为17%，一般持仓交易保证金比例为18%。
text_en: Shanghai International Energy Exchange: After study and decision, starting from the close of settlement on Monday, October 12, 2026, the price limits and trading margin ratios are adjusted as follows: the price limits for crude oil futures contracts SC2612 and SC2701, and low-sulfur fuel oil futures contracts LU2612 and LU2701 are 16%, the trading margin ratio for hedging positions is 17%, and the trading margin ratio for ordinary positions is 18%.
